prompt: How do police say they came across the evidence? Select all that apply.

options.label: They saw it in plain view
They felt it during a pat-down
They found it during a search
Your client or someone else handed it over

prompt: Did the officer have a right to be where they were when they saw the item?

options.label: Yes — somewhere they clearly had a right to be (public place, lawful stop, inside under a valid warrant)
Disputed — e.g. entered a home or yard without a warrant, went beyond a warrant or consent, or the stop itself was unlawful

prompt: Was it immediately obvious, without further investigation, that the item was contraband or evidence?

options.label: No — the officer had to examine, test, or investigate further to know

prompt: Did the officer move, open, or handle anything to see the item or its identifying details?
